tools.name: route_request
tools.title: Route AI Request
tools.description: Classify a request locally and return tier, effort, capabilities, confidence evidence, an execution plan, a budget assessment, aggregate-learning metadata, and an optional concrete model recommendation.

prompt.description: The request to route. Analysed in-process and never stored, logged, or transmitted.

context.description: Up to 8 recent conversation turns, oldest first. Used only to interpret short follow-ups such as "do it again" whose difficulty is carried by the earlier turn. Capped at 32,000 characters in total.

items.description: Metadata describing one attachment. Switchboard never receives file bytes.

name.description: File name, used for type inference only.

textLength.description: Characters of text the host extracted. Drives the long-context floor.

excerpt.description: Short excerpt used for topic signals. Send only what you are willing to share.

warnings.description: Extraction warnings, for example truncation or a parse failure.

capabilities.description: Capabilities this attachment requires of the model.

vision.description: The attachment must be interpreted visually.

longContext.description: The attachment needs a large context window.

files.description: Attachment metadata. Any attachment requires a file-capable model and raises the floor to at least balanced.

policy.description: Cost/quality preference. "best" biases upward, "fast" and "conserve" bias downward, "balanced" is neutral. A policy can move a borderline request one tier but can never route beneath a capability or safety floor. Default: balanced.

categoryBoosts.description: Per-category score nudges, keyed by task category (for example "code" or "high-stakes"). Bounded to +/-0.35 so a boost can influence a borderline decision without overriding a floor.

items.description: One model the host can actually invoke. Provider-independent by design: Switchboard never assumes a vendor.

id.description: Host-side identifier, returned verbatim in the recommendation.

family.description: Model family, used only for grouping.

tier.description: Quality tier this model belongs to.

effortLevels.description: Reasoning-effort levels this model supports. An empty array means effort is not selectable.

capabilities.description: Capability flags. Omitted keys mean unknown, which is treated differently from an explicit false.

web.description: The task needs live web access or current sources.

files.description: The task needs the model to read attached files.

longContext.description: The task needs a large context window.

code.description: The task needs code understanding or generation.

relativeCost.description: Cost normalised across your own inventory, where 1 is your most expensive model.

relativeLatency.description: Latency normalised across your own inventory, where 1 is your slowest model.

available.description: Set false to exclude the model from selection without removing it.

availableModels.description: Your model inventory. Supply it to receive a concrete model recommendation; omit it to receive a tier recommendation only.

currentModelId.description: Model already in use, preferred on ties to avoid pointless switching mid-conversation. Requires availableModels.

profile.description: Domain profile. A profile may raise a tier or capability floor; it can never lower one. Default: general.

budget.description: Optional ceilings. Switchboard reports whether the routed plan fits; it never silently violates a capability or safety floor to satisfy a budget.

maxStages.description: Largest acceptable number of execution-plan stages.

planMode.description: "single" forces a one-stage plan, "multi" forces staged execution, "auto" decides from difficulty. Default: auto.

apiVersion.description: Pin the response contract version. Defaults to the current contract.

tools.name: evaluate_router
tools.title: Evaluate Router
tools.description: Evaluate up to 100 labeled routing cases and return safety and quality metrics. Baseline metrics exclude learned preferences by default.

includePreferences.description: When true, also report the observed preference-adjusted tier while baseline metrics remain preference independent.

cases.description: Between 1 and 100 labelled cases. Reports accuracy, under-routing, over-routing, capability recall and a confusion matrix.

id.description: Identifier echoed back so failures can be traced to a case.

tools.name: record_override
tools.title: Record Aggregate Override
tools.description: Record category-level upgrade or downgrade feedback. Does not accept or store prompt text.

categories.description: Task categories the corrected decision applies to, taken verbatim from taskCategories in the route_request response — for example "code", "high-stakes", "reasoning", "research". Category names only: this tool rejects prompt text, file data, model identifiers, notes, and any field not listed here.

items.description: A lowercase category name of at most 40 characters.

selectedTier.description: The tier actually used. Higher than recommendedTier records an upgrade, lower records a downgrade. Learned downgrades can never route beneath a capability or safety floor.
